body:
Oh santa maria! I know by reading reports online that salvia is big on the 'oooo the reality is melting I'm freakin!' type of experiences but we just had a blast on this magic leaf! Laughin and laughin like we didnt laugh for years!
My background...hmmm ok lets go for better or for worse! Started off experimenting with acid pills when I was around 15 years old, tried alcohol after but hey after acid how amusing is alcohol hm? Then moved on to haschish (mmmm got hooked ever since for better or for worse), moved on to PCP, pure PCP if you please (was really big in Quebec city my hometown back in the ninetys), moved on to being a total asshole by that I mean that I spent three years shooting up heroin and cocaine (arrgh cocaine is the worst substance known to man)...After a trip to the hospital I stopped using smack and coke and replaced them with a punching bag and old school rap ( I had my withdrawal while I was unconscious for a week in the hospital..lucky me)...hmmm still smoking weed and doing ghb a couple times a week for two years now, a lil kratom now and then, like 2 times a month...thanks for reading my novel!
The setting: Around 9:30, june 2007, a campfire in a Quebec city, Canada wood, Me and two old school friends, Franko and Himler.
The experience:
T0:00 = Himmler had a few beers, Franko a few joints and me a joint and 2 ghb capfuls. The fire is nice, hypnotising, there's a baseball game on the ghetto blaster (Les Capitales de Quebec...CanAm circuit champions!!!) I start talking about trying out my leftover 15x salvia. I know from experience that this salvia is so strong I can actually smoke it as a joint and really take off so I roll two fattys so my friends can try it out, they never did so its now or never!
I have to point out one thing: Doing salvia in my living room is a little freaky I get distracted by the noise of my neighbours, my cat, my fridge, my phone, etc...But in the woods, ooooo mamamia its the right spot trust me y'all...
We smoke the first joint...
T:0:05 = HAHA! Yeah I see Himmler staring at the fire with a stoopid astonished look on his face. He actually cant believe his beer is in his hand and he'S feeling his jaw stretching out on the left! He's bragging about how gravity is starting to get crazy! Franko is starting to smile cuz he says he'S being sucked down in his chair! I'm starting to feel the gravity getting weird, the ghb makes it all mellow, no stress just a weird alien feeling, no revelations like LSD.
T:0:10 = We're all peaking now! Himmler is laughing his ass off trying to stand upright but he looks like a drunk mofo waving from side to side! He says its a totally new sensation, gravity isnt the normal one you're familiar with, he says he feels like his arms are a kilometre long and his jaw is out the socket!
Franko is laughing like a madman tryin to put wood in the fire but got big coordination problems! I'm laughin my ass off cuz its the first time they do it and theyre so funny! The visuals are exquisite. They arent fractal lookin like on LSD but are totally psychedelic, more like if everything was made like an origami, all in paper and unfolding in front of our eyes. They also have a metallic quality to them, not organic like on shrooms but more metallic like on DXM but more pronounced.
T:0:20 = The trip is wearing off already. They cant believe what they just experienced! They were scared as hell before trying it and now they're all laughing and satisfied! All three of us used to do LSD pills big time back in da dayz so dats why they were scared, they thought it was going to be as intense. Hmmm maybe next time when they try it with a bong! But with a joint its more smooth I see the trip coming it doesnt overwhelm me too much. So hey we had a blast and it was really fun to be with two old school friends and try a new substance in the wood near a fire. Perfect setting if u ask me y'all. Dats why I rolled another one after and we all laughed like mofos again. We didnt have a craving for more or a brutal comedown. A half an hour later and all was back to baseline!
(sorry for my english I'm french) :)
